title: Vu 4K (ro.product.model "VU 4K", device lushan, manufacturer HVCL, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 12
header:
Vu 4K (ro.product.model "VU 4K", device lushan, manufacturer HVCL, MediaTek), Google TV / Android 12
(SDK 31), firmware STT2.230929.001.080. Sold in India. About 1.8 GB RAM.
Vu's own packages use the com.vt prefix (the same VIDAA/Hisense stack as examples/hisense-smarttv-4k-ffm,
with many com.hisense class names inside).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/vu-4k-lushan/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/vu-4k-lushan/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (build-and-install.sh finds and disables it; do not
list it here, it must go only after the new launcher is running). Live TV app: com.vt.tv.tvcenter (set it
as live_tv_package and hide it in launcher config.xml). HDMI 1-3 and AV come from com.vt.source.external.
Already disabled at the factory, so not listed: com.mediatek.tis, com.mediatek.dtv.tvinput.isdbtuner,
com.vt.source.tuner.

USB debugging alone opens port 5555 (no wireless-debugging pairing needed). With the new launcher, the
remote's Input key still opens Vu's own input panel (com.vt.tv.input), so INPUT_KEY_SERVICE is not needed.
Tested on the day of the debloat (2026-10-19), not yet lived with for days: two reboots, both normal;
HDMI switching from the launcher's Inputs menu (opens com.vt.tv.tvcenter); apps launch from the dock.

Do NOT disable com.vt.tv.smartsense, com.vt.tv.smartsense.ui or com.vt.tv.aiot: on the Hisense with the
same stack, disabling them sent the TV to Android Recovery on the next boot.
Kept on purpose: com.vt.tvservice, com.vt.avmiddleware, com.vt.edv.drmp, com.vt.tv.commonui,
com.vt.tv.input, com.vt.tv.videocolor (picture settings), com.vt.eula (consent state other apps read),
com.vt.tv.protector, com.vt.tv.customerlauncher, com.vt.udpserver, com.vt.fte, tv.mopa.ginga,
com.vt.tv.mediacenter (USB media player), com.vt.tv.dlna, the factory apps (com.vt.factory,
com.factory.tv.at, com.at.factory.androidtvaidlservice), com.mediatek.*.
Firmware updates left ON: com.vt.tv.ota, com.vt.remoteupgrade, com.vt.tv.usbota.
Casting left ON by choice: Chromecast (com.google.android.apps.mediashell), AirPlay (com.mediatek.AirplayAPK,
airplaydaemon, partner.airplay_sys, com.vt.tv.airplaykeycheck), Miracast (com.vt.tv.mobiledeviceconnectiontips).
Google Assistant (com.google.android.katniss) left ON by choice.
